title: Camper Van Village with Food Truck
sourceTitle: POKOPIA CAMPER VANS! Functional House Build + Food Truck & Outdoor Shop!
creator: zoibean
summary: A cheerful Pokopia camper village with custom camper vans, striped awnings, outdoor seating, flowers, and cozy shop details.
publicNotes:
## Build Notes

This camper village turns two compact house builds into a cheerful little stopover: one larger camper with a striped awning and rooftop details, plus a smaller food-truck-style build with outdoor seating, flowers, lights, and display shelves.

The creator's recommended items slide calls out early-game-friendly pieces for the camper shape and roof details, including painted walls, curved eaves, glass windows, stone roof pieces, and sideways logs.
